style: Authentic live-action 35mm film still, Kodak Portra 400 colors, Christmas morning: soft cool window daylight mixed with warm string-light glow, gentle film grain, realistic skin and fur texture, natural expressions. Adults only.

frames.name: pt_a
frames.prompt: Attached photo = the real dog to recreate exactly: a medium-gold Golden Retriever with soft feathering and a forest-green fabric collar with a small round brass tag. Scene: Christmas morning in a cozy, lived-in living room. A decorated real fir tree with warm white lights and a few red and gold ornaments stands at the right edge, wrapped presents under it. A couple in their early 30s sits cross-legged on a cream wool rug in front of the tree, medium-wide shot from seated eye level, both fully visible from head to knees, slightly left of center. HIM, on the left: white American man, 32, messy sandy-brown hair, light stubble, red-and-navy tartan flannel pajama shirt. HER, on the right: Latina woman, 31, dark wavy hair in a loose bun, oversized cream cable-knit sweater, small gold stud earrings. She slides a flat, rectangular, landscape-format present (about 60 x 40 cm, wrapped in plain brown kraft paper with a thick red velvet ribbon and bow) across the rug toward him with a sly, excited smile; he looks at it, curious, grinning, hands reaching for it. The Golden Retriever lies on the rug behind them between the couple and the tree, head up, watching. Mugs of coffee on the rug, crumpled wrapping paper here and there.

frames.name: pt_b
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, close insert from his point of view, looking down at his lap: his two hands (tartan flannel pajama cuffs visible) hold an opened gift, a landscape-format ornate antique-gold carved wooden picture frame, held perfectly straight-on and parallel to the camera (no perspective tilt). Torn brown kraft paper and the red velvet ribbon surround the frame's edges in his lap. The area inside the gold frame is a completely blank, flat, evenly lit pale cream canvas: leave it EMPTY, no artwork, no picture. The frame fills about 78% of the image width and sits slightly above the vertical center. Blurred warm Christmas lights and the cream rug in the background. Ignore the wide composition of the reference; only keep his pajama shirt and the warm color grade.

frames.name: pt_c
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same couple, same living room, same dog, a few seconds later. Medium-wide shot from low seated height looking straight at the base of the Christmas tree. The landscape-format ornate antique-gold picture frame now stands upright on the rug, propped against a stack of wrapped presents directly under the tree, centered in the image, facing the camera perfectly straight-on and parallel to the image plane (no perspective tilt), its width about 52% of the image width, its center at about 45% of the image height. The area inside the gold frame is a completely blank, flat, evenly lit pale cream canvas: leave it EMPTY, no artwork. The couple sits on the rug at the left edge, turned toward the frame, smiling. The Golden Retriever is standing on the rug at the right, walking toward the frame, curious, tail up. Torn kraft paper and the red ribbon lie on the rug in front.

frames.name: pt_d
frames.prompt: Change only: the Golden Retriever now lies on the rug directly in front of and just below the picture frame, in a sphinx pose seen from the side facing left: front legs stretched forward, head up, mouth slightly open in a relaxed smile, looking to the left, exactly like a portrait pose. The couple laughs; she covers her mouth with one hand, he points at the dog. The frame interior stays a blank pale cream canvas, frame position unchanged.

frames.name: pt_e
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same living room, Christmas evening. Straight-on wide shot of a painted white fireplace mantel with three knit stockings and a pine garland with warm fairy lights. Centered above the mantel on the wall hangs the same landscape-format ornate antique-gold picture frame, perfectly straight-on and parallel to the camera (no perspective tilt), width about 60% of the image width, its center at about 33% of the image height. The area inside the gold frame is a completely blank, flat, evenly lit pale cream canvas: leave it EMPTY, no artwork. Below, the Golden Retriever sleeps curled up on the cream rug in front of the fireplace, a low warm fire glowing. No people. Warm, quiet, cozy.
